name: ePayco API operations
description: Experimental submodule of ePayco: exposes a POST endpoint (/epayco/api/operation) that runs ePayco PHP SDK operations and REST lookups (transaction info, reference info, PSE banks, arbitrary factory operations), gated by a permission.
project_description: ePayco API operations is an experimental submodule of the ePayco project. It provides a single POST endpoint, /epayco/api/operation, that runs ePayco PHP SDK operations and REST lookups through the base module's epayco.handler service. It is intended for building custom ePayco integrations that need to query transactions, references, or the PSE bank list, or run arbitrary factory operations, from HTTP callers. Access is controlled by the 'execute epayco_api operations' permission.
